product.title: Haleakala Classic Vehicle Sunrise Tour with Breakfast

description.text: See sunrise from the top of Maui’s highest volcano during this informative tour of Haleakala National Park. Climb aboard an air-conditioned vehicle for a scenic tour of the dormant volcano and crater of Haleakala and the upcountry area. Stops include Haleakalā National Park, Haleakala Summit, Makawao, Pa'ia. Learn about the culture, history, and geology of Maui during the trip. Ideal for visitors basing on Maui who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
